cs.t: I like my Chris Reeve Sebenza. Spendy, but works like a champ.  https://www.chrisreeve.com/sebenza-21.html  Honestly, the favorite pocket knife is whatever I have on me at the time. I have one of these which is TSA approved and it does ok for opening boxes and packages and stuff.  https://www.amazon.com/Boker-09BO310-Access-Prying-Steel/dp/...  I do a lot of flying. If I got a nice pocket knife I really liked and then got it confiscated, I'd be really sad. That little prybar rides on my keychain constantly and I don't have to think about it. It's not sharp as a knife, but does most of what I need to do with it day to day.
cs.th: Ask HN: What is your favorite pocket knife?
